name: bytewise-assets
description: Vite build for Bytewise (বাইটওয়াইজ)'s CSS/JS — the PHP backend is untouched by this. Bundles public/assets/css/app.css, public/assets/js/app.js, and the CodeMirror-based code editor (src/editor.js) into public/assets/dist/, which is committed so a plain deploy never needs npm install.
